metas.name: Saving Private Ryan
metas.description: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.

metas.name: Joker
metas.description: Arthur Fleck, a party clown and a failed stand-up comedian, leads an impoverished life with his ailing mother. However, when society shuns him and brands him as a freak, he decides to embrace the life of chaos in Gotham City.

metas.name: Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

metas.name: The Hangover
metas.description: Three buddies wake up from a bachelor party in Las Vegas with no memory of the previous night and the bachelor missing. They must make their way around the city in order to find their friend in time for his wedding.

metas.name: Nope
metas.description: The residents of a lonely gulch in inland California bear witness to an uncanny and chilling phenomenon.

metas.name: The Evil Dead
metas.description: Five friends travel to a cabin in the woods, where they unknowingly release flesh-possessing demons.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

metas.name: Event Horizon
metas.description: A rescue crew is tasked with investigating the mysterious reappearance of a spaceship that had been lost for seven years.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description: A kamikaze pilot plagued by survivor's guilt seeks redemption when a giant monster he failed to kill is transformed by radiation from atomic bomb tests and lays siege to post-war Japan.

metas.name: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
metas.description: A bounty-hunting scam joins two men in an uneasy alliance against a third in a race to find a fortune in gold buried in a remote cemetery.

metas.name: Shelter
metas.description: A reclusive former government assassin finds his forced isolation shattered when a stranded supply girl triggers a lethal tracking system, forcing him to defend her against his old handler's relentless execution squads.

metas.name: V for Vendetta
metas.description: A young woman living in a dystopian society meets a shadowy freedom fighter who is plotting to overthrow their tyrannical government.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: At the age of 21, Tim discovers he can travel in time and change what happens and has happened in his own life. His decision to make his world a better place by getting a girlfriend turns out not to be as easy as you might think.

metas.name: Dark Shadows
metas.description: An imprisoned vampire, Barnabas Collins, is set free and returns to his ancestral home, where his dysfunctional descendants are in need of his protection.

metas.name: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
metas.description: Forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, the Fantastic Four must defend Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic herald, the Silver Surfer.

metas.name: Magnolia
metas.description: An epic mosaic of interrelated characters search for love, forgiveness and meaning in the San Fernando Valley.

metas.name: The Handmaiden
metas.description: In 1930s Korea, a girl is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress who lives a secluded life on a countryside estate. But the maid has a secret: She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler to help seduce the Lady and steal her ...

metas.name: Hush
metas.description: A deaf mute European-American writer in her 20's who retreated to the woods to live in solitude must fight for her life in silence when a masked serial killer appears at her window.

metas.name: Kingdom of Heaven
metas.description: Balian of Ibelin travels to Jerusalem during the Crusades of the 12th century, and there he finds himself as the defender of the city and its people.

metas.name: What's Your Number?
metas.description: A woman looks back at the past nineteen men she's had relationships with in her life and wonders if one of them might be her one true love.

metas.name: The Wizard of Oz
metas.description: Young Dorothy Gale and her dog Toto are swept away by a tornado from their Kansas farm to the magical Land of Oz and embark on a quest with three new friends to see the Wizard, who can return her to her home and fulfill the others...

metas.name: Pet Sematary
metas.description: After tragedy strikes, a grieving father discovers an ancient burial ground behind his home with the power to raise the dead.

metas.name: Primal Fear
metas.description: A high-profile murder intrigues a publicity hungry lawyer.

metas.name: Risky Business
metas.description: A Chicago teenager is looking for fun at home while his parents are away, but the situation quickly gets out of hand.

metas.name: No Other Choice
metas.description: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

metas.name: The Nice Guys
metas.description: In 1970s Los Angeles, a mismatched pair of private eyes investigate a missing girl and the mysterious death of a porn star.

metas.name: Anyone But You
metas.description: After an amazing first date, Bea and Ben's fiery attraction turns ice-cold--until they find themselves unexpectedly reunited at a wedding in Australia. So they do what any two mature adults would do: pretend to be a couple.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: When renowned crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead at his estate just after his 85th birthday, the inquisitive and debonair Detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously enlisted to investigate.

metas.name: The Terminator
metas.description: A cyborg assassin from the future attempts to find and kill a young woman who is destined to give birth to a warrior that will lead a resistance to save humankind from extinction.

metas.name: Batman Begins
metas.description: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.

metas.name: The Strangers
metas.description: Three masked assailants terrorize a young couple in a romantic getaway to a remote cottage.

metas.name: Prometheus
metas.description: Following clues to the origin of mankind, a team finds a structure on a distant moon, but they soon realize they are not alone.

metas.name: Train to Busan
metas.description: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

metas.name: Scream
metas.description: 25 years after the original Woodsboro killings, a new Ghostface begins targeting teens connected to the town's dark past, drawing the final 3 survivors of the first attack back once more.

metas.name: Spider-Man
metas.description: A shy teenager is bitten by a genetically modified spider and uses his new spider-like abilities to fight injustice as a masked superhero.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: A thief and his team of associates plan a sophisticated heist to rob three Las Vegas casinos at the same time.

metas.name: Mulholland Drive
metas.description: After a car wreck on Mulholland Drive renders a woman amnesiac, she and a Hollywood-hopeful search for clues and answers across Los Angeles in a twisting venture beyond dreams and reality.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
metas.description: Harry Potter finds himself competing in a hazardous tournament between rival schools of magic, but he is distracted by recurring nightmares.

metas.name: A Clockwork Orange
metas.description: Alex DeLarge and his droogs barbarize a decaying near-future.

metas.name: The Devil Wears Prada
metas.description: An aspiring journalist starts working as an assistant to the cruel editor-in-chief of a high-fashion magazine.

metas.name: Taxi Driver
metas.description: A mentally unstable veteran works as a nighttime taxi driver in New York City, where the perceived decadence and sleaze fuels his urge for violent action.

metas.name: Split
metas.description: Three girls are kidnapped by a man with a diagnosed 23 distinct personalities. They must try to escape before the apparent emergence of a frightful new 24th.

metas.name: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
metas.description: Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark become targets of the Capitol after their victory in the 74th Hunger Games sparks a rebellion in the Districts of Panem.

metas.name: The Bourne Identity
metas.description: A man is picked up by a fishing boat, bullet-riddled and suffering from amnesia, before racing to elude assassins and attempting to regain his memory.

metas.name: The Mist
metas.description: In the small town of Bridgton, Maine, people become trapped inside a supermarket after a mysterious mist envelops the town.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description: A mysterious young woman seduces lonely men in the evening hours in Scotland. However, events lead her to begin a process of self-discovery.

metas.name: Death Becomes Her
metas.description: Two women vie for a man and the secret of eternal beauty.

metas.name: Logan
metas.description: In a future where mutants are nearly extinct, an elderly and weary Logan leads a quiet life. But when Laura, a mutant child pursued by scientists, comes to him for help, he must get her to safety.

metas.name: Minions & Monsters
metas.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.

metas.name: Blade Runner
metas.description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

April 6th, 1917. As an infantry battalion assembles to wage war deep in enemy territory, two soldiers are assigned to race against time and deliver a message that will stop 1,600 men from walking straight into a deadly trap.

metas.name: The Revenant
metas.description: A frontiersman on a fur trading expedition in the 1820s fights for survival after being mauled by a bear and left for dead by members of his own hunting team.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

metas.name: De Gaulle: Résistance
metas.description: A powerful account of Charles de Gaulle's journey during World War II, from his rise as a military leader to his emergence in French politics between 1940-1945.

metas.name: The Dark Knight Rises
metas.description: Bane, an imposing terrorist, attacks Gotham City and disrupts its eight-year-long period of peace. This forces Bruce Wayne to come out of hiding and don the cape and cowl of Batman again.

metas.name: Blink Twice
metas.description: When tech billionaire Slater King meets cocktail waitress Frida at his fundraising gala, he invites her to join him and his friends on a dream vacation on his private island. As strange things start to happen, Frida questions her ...

metas.name: Final Destination
metas.description: After getting a premonition about a plane crash on his school trip, Alex, a student, saves a few of his classmates. However, their situation gets complicated when death starts chasing them.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description: In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.

metas.name: The Little Things
metas.description: A deputy sheriff and a sergeant search for a serial killer who's terrorizing Los Angeles.

metas.name: The Voyeurs
metas.description: Pippa and Thomas move into their dream apartment, but notice that their windows look directly into the apartment opposite. This will set in motion a chain of events that will lead to disaster.

metas.name: Killers of the Flower Moon
metas.description: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one - until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
metas.description: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories forever.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A group of intergalactic criminals must pull together to stop a fanatical warrior with plans to purge the universe.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A petty thief desperate for work muscles into the world of crime journalism and becomes the star of his own story as he blurs the line between observer and participant.

metas.name: The Northman
metas.description: A young Viking prince is on a quest to avenge his father's murder.

metas.name: Saw
metas.description: Two men awaken to find themselves on the opposite sides of a dead body, each with specific instructions to kill the other, escape or face the consequences. These two are the latest contestants in Jigsaw's games.

metas.name: 2001: A Space Odyssey
metas.description: When a mysterious artifact is uncovered on the Moon, a spacecraft manned by two scientists and one supercomputer is dispatched to Jupiter to find its origins.

metas.name: A Few Good Men
metas.description: A military lawyer intends to prove that two US Marines charged with murdering a fellow Marine were only following their base commander's orders.

metas.name: Barbie
metas.description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the outside world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among regular humans.

metas.name: The Gorge
metas.description: Two operatives are appointed to posts in guard towers on opposite sides of a classified gorge.

metas.name: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
metas.description: A cyborg from the future, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: In 2027, in a chaotic world in which women have somehow become infertile, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to a sanctuary at sea.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Linguist Louise Banks leads a team of investigators when gigantic spaceships touch down around the world. As nations teeter on the verge of global war, Banks and her crew must find a way to communicate with the extraterrestrial vi...

metas.name: Full Metal Jacket
metas.description: A pragmatic U.S. Marine observes the dehumanizing effects the Vietnam War has on his fellow recruits from their brutal boot camp training to the bloody street fighting in Hue.

metas.name: Together
metas.description: Years into their relationship, Tim and Millie find themselves at a crossroads as they move to the country. With tensions already flaring, an encounter with an unnatural force threatens to corrupt their lives, their love and their ...

metas.name: Spider-Man: Far from Home
metas.description: Peter Parker heads to Europe hoping for a normal summer, but elemental attacks and a mysterious new hero pull him back into a dangerous fight he isn't ready to embrace.

metas.name: American Animals
metas.description: Four young men mistake their lives for a movie and attempt one of the most audacious heists in U.S. history.

metas.name: The Town
metas.description: A proficient group of thieves rob a bank and hold the manager hostage. Things begin to get complicated when one of the crew members falls in love with her.

metas.name: What Women Want
metas.description: A cocky, chauvinistic advertising executive magically acquires the ability to hear what women are thinking.

metas.name: Die My Love
metas.description: A writer and young mother is suffering post-partum depression and slowly spiralling into madness. Moving into an old house with her husband, she grows more and more agitated and erratic as her mind begins to unravel.

metas.name: Love Actually
metas.description: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

metas.name: Avengers: Infinity War
metas.description: The Avengers and their allies must be willing to sacrifice all in an attempt to defeat the powerful Thanos before his blitz of devastation and ruin puts an end to the universe.

metas.name: Halloween II
metas.description: While Dr. Loomis hunts for Michael Myers, a traumatized Laurie is rushed to Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, and The Shape is not far behind her.

metas.name: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
metas.description: A mother personally challenges the local authorities to solve her daughter's murder when they fail to catch the culprit.

metas.name: Transformers
metas.description: An ancient struggle between two Cybertronian races, the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons, comes to Earth, with a clue to the ultimate power held by a teenager.

metas.name: The Faculty
metas.description: Six misfit students must band together to save mankind when mind-controlling parasites from another planet infect their high school's faculty.

metas.name: Soylent Green
metas.description: A nightmarish futuristic fantasy about the controlling power of big corporations and an innocent cop who stumbles on the truth.

metas.name: Dune
metas.description: A Duke's son leads desert warriors against the galactic emperor and his father's evil nemesis to free their desert world from the emperor's rule.

metas.name: The Shadow's Edge
metas.description: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.

metas.name: Oddity
metas.description: A psychic medium attempts to uncover the truth behind her sister's murder at the site of the crime.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
metas.description: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

metas.name: Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: Tenet
metas.description: Armed with only the word "Tenet," and fighting for the survival of the entire world, CIA operative, The Protagonist, journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a global mission that unfolds beyond real time.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: Viago, Deacon, and Vladislav are vampires who are struggling with the mundane aspects of modern life, like paying rent, keeping up with the chore wheel, trying to get into nightclubs, and overcoming flatmate conflicts.

metas.name: Dawn of the Dead
metas.description: A nurse, a policeman, a young married couple and other survivors of a worldwide plague that is producing aggressive, flesh-eating zombies take refuge in a mega Midwestern shopping mall.

metas.name: Scream VI
metas.description: After surviving the latest Woodsboro murders, a group of teens move to New York City, hoping for a fresh start, only to find a new killer picking up where the last Ghostface killer left off.

metas.name: The Intouchables

metas.name: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
metas.description: An advertising executive and ladies' man, to win a big campaign, bets that he can make a woman fall in love with him in 10 days.

metas.name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
metas.description: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape from Earth and return to his home planet.

metas.name: Death on the Nile
metas.description: While on vacation on the Nile, Hercule Poirot must investigate the murder of a young heiress.
